dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A series of high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible, characterized by irregular, jagged light-intensity perimeters. The transition from the dark background to the light-grey ring edges is sharp, particularly in the 3-5 most prominent structures located in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters. Most light-colored features are organized into annular structures with dark centers, though a few localized, asymmetrical clusters of solid light pixels are visible near the anterior-dorsal neck junction.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form a distinct scalene triangle. Connecting these with the centroids of two smaller adjacent lateral annuli creates an irregular pentagonal polygon.
